sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "signals"."telescref" AS e, AVG("signals"."pulsepersec") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("signals"."polarangledeg" - "signals"."phaseshiftdeg") AS REAL) / "signals"."phaseshiftdeg")) AS m2 FROM "signals" GROUP BY "signals"."telescref"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: signals.relative difference of polarization angle from phase shift
why: average of pulse repetition rate per telescopes (by telescref)
(polarization angle - phase shift) / phase shift: the relative difference of two quantities in degree
average of relative difference of polarization angle from phase shift per telescopes (by telescref)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of polarization angle from phase shift (all level)
